title: Coefficientwise ring homomorphisms commute with the formal exponential
statement:
Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative $\mathbf Q$-algebras (any ring homomorphism between $\mathbf Q$-algebras is $\mathbf Q$-linear), $T$ an indeterminate, and $\varphi:R[[T]]\to S[[T]]$ also the coefficientwise map $\sum_nc_nT^n\mapsto\sum_n\varphi(c_n)T^n$ [def-weil-coefficientwise-ring-hom-map]. For every $U\in TR[[T]]$ (constant coefficient $0$), $\varphi(U)\in TS[[T]]$ and

$$
 \varphi\bigl(\exp(U)\bigr)=\exp\bigl(\varphi(U)\bigr)
$$

in $S[[T]]$, where $\exp$ is the formal exponential [def-weil-power-series-exponential].

source.place: proof of Corollary 27.8, p. 156: Z(X_0,t), a series with coefficients in Q, is read in Q_l[[t]] in Theorem 27.6 (used without statement)

mathlib_searches.results: PowerSeries.map_exp (Exp.lean:64): map f (exp A) = exp A' for f : A →+* A' of Q-algebras; PowerSeries.map_subst (Substitution.lean:329): (f.subst a).map h = (f.map h).subst (a.map h) for HasSubst a
mathlib_searches.verdict: generalization: the two lemmas give the statement in one line

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: with exp(U) = (PowerSeries.exp R).subst U, `PowerSeries.map_subst (HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' hU) (exp R)` gives ((exp R).subst U).map φ = ((exp R).map φ).subst (U.map φ), and `PowerSeries.map_exp` (Mathlib/RingTheory/PowerSeries/Exp.lean:64) rewrites (exp R).map φ = exp S
